purpose_context: Allow proposal authors to recover from target-branch divergence without rewriting signed history. Each resolved head becomes a linked immutable revision, exact-head review and CI evidence starts fresh, and disconnected sibling revisions remain visible without inventing a global latest proposal.
purpose_tldr: Recover conflicted proposals through immutable, explicitly linked revisions.
source_description: Add repository-native proposal revision and supersession semantics for merge-conflict recovery, with sibling revisions preserved.
